## 2.1 The same credit scoring benchmark

```{r step-002}
source("chapters/01-logistic/helpers/models.R")
source("shared/formatting.R")
source("shared/figure-theme.R")
library(rpart)
library(xgboost)
actual_default_tree <- as.numeric(as.character(test$loan_st))
brier_score <- function(actual, predicted_probability) {
  mean((predicted_probability - actual)^2)
}
```

```{r step-003}
model_metrics |>
  mutate(
    auc = round(auc, 4),
    brier_score = round(brier_score, 4),
    brier_skill = round(brier_skill, 4)
  )
```

## 2.2 A single decision tree

```{r step-004}
tree_formula <- loan_st ~ age + int + grade + log(l_amnt) + log(income) +
  emp_len + home + sex + region

simple_tree <- rpart::rpart(
  tree_formula,
  data = train,
  method = "class",
  control = rpart::rpart.control(
    maxdepth = 4,
    minsplit = 100,
    cp = 0.001
  )
)

simple_tree
```

```{r step-005}
printed_tree_frame <- simple_tree$frame
printed_leaf_rows <- which(printed_tree_frame$var == "<leaf>")
printed_example_row <- printed_leaf_rows[
  which.max(printed_tree_frame$yval2[printed_leaf_rows, 5])
]
printed_example <- printed_tree_frame[printed_example_row, ]
printed_example_id <- as.integer(rownames(printed_example))
printed_example_rule <- labels(simple_tree, minlength = 0)[printed_example_row]
```

### How the first split separates risk

```{r step-006}
first_split <- simple_tree$frame[c("1", "2", "3"), ]
split_n <- first_split$n
split_pd <- first_split$yval2[, 5]
split_gini <- 2 * split_pd * (1 - split_pd)
children_gini <- sum(split_n[2:3] * split_gini[2:3]) / split_n[1]
gini_reduction <- split_gini[1] - children_gini
gini_reduction
```

```{r step-007}
tree_frame <- simple_tree$frame
tree_nodes <- data.frame(
  node_id = as.integer(row.names(tree_frame)),
  row_id = seq_len(nrow(tree_frame)),
  split_variable = tree_frame$var,
  n = tree_frame$n,
  default_count = tree_frame$yval2[, 3],
  default_rate = tree_frame$yval2[, 5],
  is_leaf = tree_frame$var == "<leaf>",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

### Figure 2.1 {#result-figure-2-1}

```{r figure-2-1}
#| fig-width: 5.5
#| fig-height: 6.2
#| fig-cap: "Figure 2.1. A single decision tree for credit scoring."
tree_nodes$parent_id <- ifelse(tree_nodes$node_id == 1, NA, tree_nodes$node_id %/% 2)
tree_nodes$depth <- floor(log2(tree_nodes$node_id))
tree_node_rules <- labels(simple_tree, minlength = 0)

clean_tree_rule <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("sex=0", "sex = 0 (male)", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("sex=1", "sex = 1 (female)", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(",", ", ", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("log\\(l_amnt\\)", "log(loan amount)", x)
  x <- gsub("log\\(income\\)", "log(income)", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bint\\b", "interest rate", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bl_amnt\\b", "loan amount", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bemp_len\\b", "employment length", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bloan_st\\b", "default", x)
  x <- gsub("<", " < ", x)
  x <- gsub(">=", " >= ", x)
  x <- gsub("  +", " ", x)
  trimws(x)
}

tree_nodes$node_rule <- clean_tree_rule(tree_node_rules)
tree_nodes$node_rule[tree_nodes$node_id == 1] <- "All training applicants"
tree_nodes$node_type <- ifelse(tree_nodes$is_leaf, "Leaf", "Node")
tree_nodes$node_rule_plot <- vapply(
  tree_nodes$node_rule,
  function(rule_i) paste(strwrap(rule_i, width = 14), collapse = "\n"),
  character(1)
)
leaf_ids <- tree_nodes$node_id[tree_nodes$is_leaf]
tree_nodes$leaf_number <- NA_integer_
tree_nodes$leaf_number[tree_nodes$is_leaf] <- seq_along(leaf_ids)
tree_nodes$node_heading <- ifelse(
  tree_nodes$is_leaf,
  paste0("Leaf ", tree_nodes$leaf_number),
  ifelse(tree_nodes$node_id == 1, "Root", "Split")
)

tree_nodes$x <- NA_real_
tree_nodes$x[tree_nodes$is_leaf] <- seq_along(leaf_ids)

for (depth_i in rev(seq_len(max(tree_nodes$depth) + 1) - 1)) {
  parent_rows <- which(tree_nodes$depth == depth_i & !tree_nodes$is_leaf)
  for (row_i in parent_rows) {
    child_rows <- which(tree_nodes$parent_id == tree_nodes$node_id[row_i])
    tree_nodes$x[row_i] <- mean(tree_nodes$x[child_rows], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
}
tree_nodes$y <- -tree_nodes$depth
tree_x_limits <- range(tree_nodes$x, na.rm = TRUE) + c(-0.55, 0.55)
tree_y_limits <- range(tree_nodes$y, na.rm = TRUE) + c(-0.55, 0.55)

tree_nodes$node_label <- paste0(
  tree_nodes$node_heading,
  "\n",
  tree_nodes$node_rule_plot,
  "\nPD = ", fmt_pct(tree_nodes$default_rate, 1),
  "\n", fmt_int(tree_nodes$default_count), " / ", fmt_int(tree_nodes$n)
)

tree_edges <- merge(
  tree_nodes[, c("node_id", "x", "y")],
  tree_nodes[, c("node_id", "parent_id", "x", "y")],
  by.x = "node_id",
  by.y = "parent_id",
  suffixes = c("_parent", "_child")
)

ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::geom_segment(
    data = tree_edges,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = x_parent,
      y = y_parent,
      xend = x_child,
      yend = y_child
    ),
    linewidth = 0.35,
    color = book_plot_colors[["reference"]]
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_label(
    data = tree_nodes,
    ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, label = node_label, fill = default_rate),
    label.size = 0,
    linewidth = 0,
    label.padding = grid::unit(0.24, "lines"),
    size = 3,
    lineheight = 0.95,
    color = "gray10"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#E5F0F7", "#F4D5A0", "#D67560"),
    labels = function(x) fmt_pct(x, 0),
    name = "Node PD",
    guide = ggplot2::guide_colorbar(barwidth = 7, barheight = 0.5)
  ) +
  ggplot2::coord_cartesian(
    xlim = tree_x_limits,
    ylim = tree_y_limits,
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  book_figure_theme() +
  ggplot2::theme_void(base_size = 10) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9),
    legend.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.margin = grid::unit(c(8, 10, 8, 10), "pt")
  )
```

```{r table-2-1}
leaf_paths <- path.rpart(simple_tree, nodes = leaf_ids, print.it = FALSE)

leaf_path_plain <- vapply(leaf_paths, function(path_i) {

  paste(path_i, collapse = "; ")

leaf_path_text <- vapply(leaf_paths, function(path_i) {

  path_i <- gsub(">=", "&gt;=", path_i, fixed = TRUE)
  path_i <- gsub("<", "&lt;", path_i, fixed = TRUE)
```

## 2.4 From trees to boosted trees

```{r step-016}
xgb_params <- list(
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric = c("logloss", "auc"),
  max_depth = 3,
  eta = 0.05,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  min_child_weight = 20,
  lambda = 1,
  base_score = mean(xgb_train_label)
)
xgb_nrounds <- 160
xgb_checkpoint_rounds <- c(5, 20, 60, 100, xgb_nrounds)
xgb_base_pd <- xgb_params$base_score
xgb_base_score <- qlogis(xgb_base_pd)
```

### Table 2.5 {#result-table-2-5}

```{r table-2-5}
xgb_path_settings_table <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c(
    "`objective`",
    "`max_depth`",
    "`eta`",
    "`subsample`",
    "`colsample_bytree`",
    "`min_child_weight`",
    "`lambda`",
    "`base_score`",
    "Full-model `nrounds`",
    "Checkpoint rounds"
  ),
  Value = c(
    "`binary:logistic`",
    xgb_params$max_depth,
    xgb_params$eta,
    xgb_params$subsample,
    xgb_params$colsample_bytree,
    xgb_params$min_child_weight,
    xgb_params$lambda,
    fmt_pct(xgb_base_pd, 2),
    xgb_nrounds,
    paste(c(0, xgb_checkpoint_rounds), collapse = ", ")
  ),
  Role = c(
    "Fits a binary default model and returns probabilities after the logistic transformation.",
    "Limits each individual tree to shallow interactions.",
    "Learning rate; controls how much each new tree can change the running score.",
    "Uses a fraction of training rows in each boosting round.",
    "Uses a fraction of encoded predictors in each boosting round.",
    "Sets the minimum sum of curvature weights in each child node.",
    "Regularization penalty on leaf corrections; higher values shrink leaf values.",
    "Initial PD before any tree is added.",
    "Number of boosted trees in the full model.",
    "Selected rounds used only to inspect the prediction path."
  ),
  check.names = FALSE
)

companion_kable(
  xgb_path_settings_table,
  caption = "XGBoost settings used for the checkpoint path and the full model.",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

For binary log-loss, each observation contributes a curvature weight (Hessian) $p(1-p)$, where $p$ is its current fitted PD. These weights describe how the loss responds to changes in the model's score. The `min_child_weight` setting requires their sum in each child node to be at least `r xgb_params$min_child_weight`, rather than a count of applicants.

```{r step-018}
xgb_checkpoint_models <- lapply(xgb_checkpoint_rounds, function(rounds) {
  set.seed(567)
  xgboost::xgb.train(
    params = xgb_params,
    data = xgb_train,
    nrounds = rounds,
    verbose = 0
  )
})
xgb_full_checkpoint_model <- xgb_checkpoint_models[[length(xgb_checkpoint_models)]]

xgb_checkpoint_margin_matrix <- sapply(
  xgb_checkpoint_models,
  function(model_i) predict(model_i, newdata = xgb_test, outputmargin = TRUE)
)
colnames(xgb_checkpoint_margin_matrix) <- as.character(xgb_checkpoint_rounds)
xgb_checkpoint_pd_matrix <- plogis(xgb_checkpoint_margin_matrix)

xgb_path_score_matrix <- cbind(
  "0" = xgb_base_score,
  xgb_checkpoint_margin_matrix
)
xgb_path_pd_matrix <- cbind(
  "0" = xgb_base_pd,
  xgb_checkpoint_pd_matrix
)
colnames(xgb_path_score_matrix) <- c(0, xgb_checkpoint_rounds)
colnames(xgb_path_pd_matrix) <- c(0, xgb_checkpoint_rounds)

xgb_path_log_loss <- function(actual, predicted_pd) {
  predicted_pd <- pmin(pmax(predicted_pd, 1e-8), 1 - 1e-8)
  -(actual * log(predicted_pd) + (1 - actual) * log(1 - predicted_pd))
}

xgb_base_loss <- xgb_path_log_loss(actual_default_tree, xgb_base_pd)
xgb_full_loss <- xgb_path_log_loss(
  actual_default_tree,
  xgb_path_pd_matrix[, as.character(xgb_nrounds)]
)
xgb_loss_gain <- xgb_base_loss - xgb_full_loss
xgb_visible_move <- rowSums(abs(t(apply(xgb_path_score_matrix, 1, diff))))

xgb_default_candidates <- which(
  actual_default_tree == 1 &
    xgb_path_pd_matrix[, as.character(xgb_nrounds)] > xgb_base_pd
)
xgb_nondefault_candidates <- which(
  actual_default_tree == 0 &
    xgb_path_pd_matrix[, as.character(xgb_nrounds)] < xgb_base_pd
)

if (length(xgb_default_candidates) > 0) {
  xgb_default_index <- xgb_default_candidates[
    which.max(xgb_loss_gain[xgb_default_candidates] +
                0.05 * xgb_visible_move[xgb_default_candidates])
  ]
} else {
  xgb_default_index <- which.max(xgb_loss_gain + 0.05 * xgb_visible_move)
}

if (length(xgb_nondefault_candidates) > 0) {
  xgb_nondefault_index <- xgb_nondefault_candidates[
    which.max(xgb_loss_gain[xgb_nondefault_candidates] +
                0.05 * xgb_visible_move[xgb_nondefault_candidates])
  ]
} else {
  xgb_nondefault_index <- which.max(-xgb_full_loss + 0.05 * xgb_visible_move)
}

xgb_case_indices <- c(
  "Default case" = xgb_default_index,
  "Non-default case" = xgb_nondefault_index
)
```

### Table 2.6 {#result-table-2-6}

```{r table-2-6}
format_rate <- function(x) {
  ifelse(abs(x) > 1, paste0(fmt_num(x, 2), "%"), fmt_pct(x, 2))
}

format_money_value <- function(x) {
  paste0("$", fmt_num(x, 0))
}

format_emp_len_value <- function(x) {
  paste0(fmt_num(as.numeric(x), 2), " years")
}

format_sex_value <- function(x) {
  sex_code <- as.character(x)
  sex_label <- ifelse(
    sex_code == "1",
    "female",
    ifelse(sex_code == "0", "male", "unknown")
  )
  paste0(sex_code, " (", sex_label, ")")
}

format_region_value <- function(x) {
  region_code <- as.character(x)
  region_label <- c(
    "N" = "North",
    "E" = "East",
    "W" = "West",
    "S" = "South",
    "NE" = "Northeast",
    "NW" = "Northwest",
    "SE" = "Southeast",
    "SW" = "Southwest"
  )[region_code]
  region_label <- ifelse(is.na(region_label), "unknown", region_label)
  paste0(region_code, " (", region_label, ")")
}

build_xgb_case_path <- function(case_name, row_index) {
  path_rounds <- as.integer(colnames(xgb_path_pd_matrix))
  path_scores <- as.numeric(xgb_path_score_matrix[row_index, ])
  path_pds <- as.numeric(xgb_path_pd_matrix[row_index, ])
  checkpoint_label <- c(
    "0 (base)",
    paste0(path_rounds[-1], " (+", diff(path_rounds), " trees)")
  )
  data.frame(
    case = case_name,
    checkpoint = checkpoint_label,
    score_change = c(
      "",
      fmt_num(diff(path_scores), 4)
    ),
    running_score = fmt_num(path_scores, 4),
    predicted_PD = fmt_pct(path_pds, 2),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}

xgb_round_path <- do.call(
  rbind,
  Map(build_xgb_case_path, names(xgb_case_indices), xgb_case_indices)
)

xgb_profile_quantities <- c(
  "Test-set row",
  "Observed outcome",
  "Age",
  "Interest rate",
  "Grade",
  "Loan amount",
  "Income",
  "Employment length",
  "Home ownership",
  "Sex",
  "Region",
  "Base PD",
  "PD after 5 rounds",
  "PD after 20 rounds",
  "Full XGBoost PD"
)

xgb_case_profile_values <- lapply(xgb_case_indices, function(row_index) {
  applicant_i <- test[row_index, ]
  c(
    row_index,
    ifelse(actual_default_tree[row_index] == 1, "Default", "No default"),
    applicant_i$age,
    format_rate(applicant_i$int),
    as.character(applicant_i$grade),
    format_money_value(applicant_i$l_amnt),
    format_money_value(applicant_i$income),
    format_emp_len_value(applicant_i$emp_len),
    as.character(applicant_i$home),
    format_sex_value(applicant_i$sex),
    format_region_value(applicant_i$region),
    fmt_pct(xgb_base_pd, 2),
    fmt_pct(xgb_path_pd_matrix[row_index, "5"], 2),
    fmt_pct(xgb_path_pd_matrix[row_index, "20"], 2),
    fmt_pct(xgb_path_pd_matrix[row_index, as.character(xgb_nrounds)], 2)
  )
})

xgb_applicant_profile <- data.frame(
  Quantity = xgb_profile_quantities,
  check.names = FALSE
)
xgb_applicant_profile[names(xgb_case_indices)] <- xgb_case_profile_values

xgb_loss_check <- data.frame(
  case = names(xgb_case_indices),
  observed_outcome = ifelse(
    actual_default_tree[xgb_case_indices] == 1,
    "Default",
    "No default"
  ),
  base_PD = fmt_pct(rep(xgb_base_pd, length(xgb_case_indices)), 2),
  PD_after_5_rounds = fmt_pct(
    xgb_path_pd_matrix[xgb_case_indices, "5"],
    2
  ),
  full_xgboost_PD = fmt_pct(
    xgb_path_pd_matrix[xgb_case_indices, as.character(xgb_nrounds)],
    2
  ),
  base_log_loss = fmt_num(xgb_base_loss[xgb_case_indices], 4),
  full_log_loss = fmt_num(xgb_full_loss[xgb_case_indices], 4),
  loss_reduction = fmt_num(xgb_loss_gain[xgb_case_indices], 4),
  check.names = FALSE
)

companion_kable(
  xgb_applicant_profile,
  caption = "Applicants selected to inspect two XGBoost checkpoint paths.",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

### Table 2.7 {#result-table-2-7}

```{r table-2-7}
companion_kable(
```

### Tracing the first two boosting rounds

```{r step-022}
xgb_tree_table <- as.data.frame(
  xgboost::xgb.model.dt.tree(model = xgb_full_checkpoint_model)
)
xgb_leaf_matrix <- predict(
  xgb_full_checkpoint_model,
  newdata = xgb_test,
  predleaf = TRUE
)
if (is.null(dim(xgb_leaf_matrix))) {
  xgb_leaf_matrix <- matrix(xgb_leaf_matrix, ncol = xgb_nrounds)
}

xgb_first_five_models <- lapply(seq_len(5), function(rounds) {
  set.seed(567)
  xgboost::xgb.train(
    params = xgb_params,
    data = xgb_train,
    nrounds = rounds,
    verbose = 0
  )
})

xgb_default_applicant <- xgb_test[xgb_default_index, ]
xgb_default_leaf_matrix <- predict(
  xgb_full_checkpoint_model,
  newdata = xgb_default_applicant,
  predleaf = TRUE
)

xgb_first_five_scores <- sapply(
  xgb_first_five_models,
  function(model_i) predict(
    model_i,
    newdata = xgb_default_applicant,
    outputmargin = TRUE
  )
)

xgb_first_five_scores <- as.numeric(xgb_first_five_scores)
xgb_first_five_previous_scores <- c(xgb_base_score, xgb_first_five_scores[-5])
xgb_first_five_observed_changes <- xgb_first_five_scores -
  xgb_first_five_previous_scores
xgb_first_five_selected_leaf <- as.integer(
  xgb_default_leaf_matrix[seq_len(5)]
)

xgb_leaf_value_for_round <- function(round_number, leaf_id) {
  tree_rows <- xgb_tree_table[xgb_tree_table$Tree == round_number - 1, ]
  leaf_row <- tree_rows[
    tree_rows$Feature == "Leaf" &
      tree_rows$Node == leaf_id,
  ]
  if (nrow(leaf_row) == 0) {
    leaf_row <- tree_rows[
      tree_rows$Feature == "Leaf" &
        tree_rows$ID == paste0(round_number - 1, "-", leaf_id),
    ]
  }
  if (nrow(leaf_row) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  value_column <- intersect(c("Quality", "Gain", "Weight"), names(leaf_row))[1]
  if (is.na(value_column)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  as.numeric(leaf_row[[value_column]][1])
}

xgb_first_five_leaf_values <- vapply(
  seq_len(5),
  function(round_i) {
    xgb_leaf_value_for_round(
      round_number = round_i,
      leaf_id = xgb_first_five_selected_leaf[round_i]
    )
  },
  numeric(1)
)

xgb_round_1_leaf <- xgb_first_five_selected_leaf[1]
xgb_round_1_leaf_value <- xgb_first_five_leaf_values[1]
xgb_round_1_score <- xgb_first_five_scores[1]
xgb_round_1_pd <- plogis(xgb_round_1_score)
xgb_round_1_logistic_exponent <- -xgb_round_1_score
xgb_round_2_leaf <- xgb_first_five_selected_leaf[2]
xgb_round_2_leaf_value <- xgb_first_five_leaf_values[2]
xgb_round_2_score <- xgb_first_five_scores[2]
xgb_round_2_pd <- plogis(xgb_round_2_score)
xgb_round_2_logistic_exponent <- -xgb_round_2_score
```

```{r table-2-9}
html_code <- function(x) {
  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) return(paste0("`", x, "`"))
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  paste0("<code>", x, "</code>")
}

math_inline <- function(x) {
  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
    x <- gsub("<sub>([^<]*)</sub>", "_{\\1}", x)
    x <- gsub("log(", "\\log(", x, fixed = TRUE)
    x <- gsub("exp(", "\\exp(", x, fixed = TRUE)
    return(paste0("$", x, "$"))
  }
  paste0("<span class=\"math-table\">", x, "</span>")
}
```

```{r table-2-10}
xgb_first_five_arithmetic <- data.frame(
  round = 0:5,
  code_value = c(

    paste0("leaf ", xgb_first_five_selected_leaf,
           " value = ", fmt_num(xgb_first_five_leaf_values, 4))

    math_inline(paste0("F<sub>0</sub> = ", fmt_num(xgb_base_score, 4))),

          " + ",

      seq_len(5),
      xgb_first_five_previous_scores,
      xgb_first_five_leaf_values,
      xgb_first_five_scores
    )
  ),
  predicted_PD = fmt_pct(plogis(c(xgb_base_score, xgb_first_five_scores)), 2),

)
```

```{r step-029}
pred_xgb_train <- predict(xgb_model, newdata = xgb_train)
ROC_xgb_train <- pROC::roc(train$loan_st, pred_xgb_train, quiet = TRUE)

xgb_estimation_log_loss <- function(actual, predicted_pd) {
  predicted_pd <- pmin(pmax(predicted_pd, 1e-8), 1 - 1e-8)
  mean(-(actual * log(predicted_pd) +
           (1 - actual) * log(1 - predicted_pd)))
}

xgb_train_auc_estimated <- as.numeric(auc(ROC_xgb_train))
xgb_test_auc_estimated <- as.numeric(auc(ROC_xgb))
xgb_test_logloss_estimated <- xgb_estimation_log_loss(
  actual_default_tree,
  pred_xgb
)
```

### Checking performance over boosting rounds

```{r step-035}
xgb_round_grid <- seq(20, xgb_nrounds, 20)
xgb_learning_curve <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(xgb_round_grid, function(rounds) {
    set.seed(567)
    model_i <- xgboost::xgb.train(
      params = xgb_params,
      data = xgb_train,
      nrounds = rounds,
      verbose = 0
    )

    pred_train_i <- predict(model_i, newdata = xgb_train)
    pred_test_i <- predict(model_i, newdata = xgb_test)

    data.frame(
      rounds = rounds,
      series = c("Train AUC", "Test AUC"),
      auc = c(
        as.numeric(pROC::auc(train$loan_st, pred_train_i, quiet = TRUE)),
        as.numeric(pROC::auc(test$loan_st, pred_test_i, quiet = TRUE))
      )
    )
  })
)
```

```{r step-036}
xgb_final_round <- max(xgb_learning_curve$rounds)
xgb_final_train_auc <- xgb_learning_curve$auc[
  xgb_learning_curve$rounds == xgb_final_round &
    xgb_learning_curve$series == "Train AUC"
]
xgb_final_test_auc <- xgb_learning_curve$auc[
  xgb_learning_curve$rounds == xgb_final_round &
    xgb_learning_curve$series == "Test AUC"
]
xgb_final_auc_gap <- xgb_final_train_auc - xgb_final_test_auc
xgb_test_curve <- xgb_learning_curve[xgb_learning_curve$series == "Test AUC", ]
xgb_train_curve <- xgb_learning_curve[xgb_learning_curve$series == "Train AUC", ]
xgb_best_test_row <- xgb_test_curve[which.max(xgb_test_curve$auc), ]
xgb_previous_test_auc <- xgb_test_curve$auc[nrow(xgb_test_curve) - 1]
xgb_test_auc_last_change <- xgb_final_test_auc - xgb_previous_test_auc
xgb_test_auc_declines_after_best <- xgb_best_test_row$rounds < xgb_final_round &&
  xgb_final_test_auc < xgb_best_test_row$auc
```

```{r step-037}
  geom_point(size = 2)
```

```{r step-046}

                               drop = FALSE]

) |> arrange(desc(mean_abs_shap))

xgb_shap_plot <- xgb_shap_importance |>

  geom_col(fill = book_tree_colors[["xgboost"]])
```

### How predictions respond to one variable

```{r step-054}
partial_dependence <- function(variable, grid_values) {
  data.frame(
    variable = variable,
    value = grid_values,
    average_predicted_pd = sapply(grid_values, function(value) {
      new_data <- test
      new_data[[variable]] <- value
      new_matrix <- model.matrix(xgb_formula, data = new_data)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
      mean(predict(xgb_model, newdata = new_matrix))
    })
  )
}
partial_dependence_data <- bind_rows(lapply(c("int", "income", "age"), function(variable) {
  grid_values <- seq(quantile(test[[variable]], 0.05),
                     quantile(test[[variable]], 0.95), length.out = 40)
  partial_dependence(variable, grid_values)
}))
pd_plot <- partial_dependence_data |>
  mutate(
    variable = recode(variable,
                      "int" = "Interest rate (%)",
                      "income" = "Income (USD)",
                      "age" = "Age (years)")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = value, y = average_predicted_pd)) +
  geom_line(color = book_tree_colors[["xgboost"]], linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_x", ncol = 1)
```

```{r shared-scoring-definitions}
#| eval: false
```

```{r step-057}
source("shared/scoring.R")
strategy_curve <- function(model_name, prob_of_default,
                           acceptance_grid = seq(.50, .95, .05),
                           good_loan_payoff = 1, bad_loan_cost = 5) {
  credit_policy_curve(actual_default_tree, model_name, prob_of_default,
                      acceptance_grid, good_loan_payoff, bad_loan_cost)
}

calibration_table <- function(model_name, prob_of_default, groups = 10) {
  credit_calibration_table(actual_default_tree, as.integer(rownames(test)),
                           model_name, prob_of_default, groups)
}

constant_default_rate <- rep(mean(actual_default_tree), length(actual_default_tree))
model_metrics <- data.frame(
  model = c("logi_full", "single_tree", "xgboost", "constant default rate"),
  auc = c(as.numeric(auc(ROC_logi_full)), as.numeric(auc(ROC_tree_simple)),
          as.numeric(auc(ROC_xgb)), NA_real_),
  brier_score = c(brier_score(actual_default_tree, pred_logi_full),
                  brier_score(actual_default_tree, pred_tree_simple),
                  brier_score(actual_default_tree, pred_xgb),
                  brier_score(actual_default_tree, constant_default_rate))
)
baseline_brier <- model_metrics$brier_score[model_metrics$model == "constant default rate"]
model_metrics$brier_skill <- 1 - model_metrics$brier_score / baseline_brier
strategy_comparison <- bind_rows(
  strategy_curve("logi_full", pred_logi_full),
  strategy_curve("single_tree", pred_tree_simple),
  strategy_curve("xgboost", pred_xgb)
)
calibration_comparison <- bind_rows(
  calibration_table("logi_full", pred_logi_full),
  calibration_table("xgboost", pred_xgb)
)
```

```{r step-058}
best_auc_row <- model_metrics_core |>

best_brier_row <- model_metrics_core |>

strategy_80 <- strategy_comparison |>

best_strategy_overall <- best_strategy_by_model |>

xgb_metric_row <- model_metrics_core |>
  filter(model == "xgboost")

logi_metric_row <- model_metrics_core |>
  filter(model == "logi_full")

xgb_best_strategy_row <- best_strategy_by_model |>
  filter(model == "xgboost")

xgb_payoff_minus_logi <- xgb_best_strategy_row$net_payoff -
  logi_best_strategy_row$net_payoff

}
```

```{r step-060}
roc_to_df <- function(roc_object, model_name) {
  data.frame(
    false_positive_rate = 1 - roc_object$specificities,
    true_positive_rate = roc_object$sensitivities,
    model = model_name,
    auc = as.numeric(auc(roc_object))
  )
}

roc_comparison <- bind_rows(
  roc_to_df(ROC_logi_full, "Logistic regression"),

) |>
  mutate(
    model_label = paste0(model, " (AUC = ", round(auc, 4), ")"),
    model_label = factor(
      model_label,
      levels = unique(model_label)
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(model_label, false_positive_rate)
```

```{r step-063}
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
```
```{r step-065}
  geom_point(size = 2)
```

```{r table-2-21}
best_strategy_overall_check <- data.frame(

    "Model",

    "Accepted default loans",
    "Cost from default loans ($5 each)",
    "Net payoff"
  ),
  Value = c(
    best_strategy_overall$model,
    fmt_pct(best_strategy_overall$accept_rate, 0),
    fmt_int(best_strategy_overall$accepted_good),
    fmt_dollar(best_strategy_overall$accepted_good * 1),
    fmt_int(best_strategy_overall$accepted_defaults),
    fmt_dollar(-best_strategy_overall$accepted_defaults * 5),
    fmt_dollar(best_strategy_overall$net_payoff)
```

### Table 2.22 {#result-table-2-22}

```{r table-2-22}
best_strategy_by_model_table <- strategy_comparison |>
  group_by(model) |>
  slice_max(net_payoff, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(model, accept_rate, actual_accept_rate, cutoff, bad_rate, net_payoff) |>
  mutate(
    accept_rate = fmt_pct(accept_rate, 0),
    actual_accept_rate = fmt_pct(actual_accept_rate, 2),
    cutoff = fmt_pct(cutoff, 2),
    bad_rate = fmt_pct(bad_rate, 2),
    net_payoff = fmt_dollar(net_payoff)
  )

companion_kable(
  best_strategy_by_model_table,
  caption = "Best net-payoff row by model.",
  col.names = c("Model", "Target", "Accepted", "PD cutoff", "Bad rate", "Net payoff"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
